subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after_compaction plugin hooks gain a permanent current-session-only resetSession(reason?) API with lifecycle-owned deferred execution?
rationale: This creates a new plugin capability and compatibility contract; source review can assess implementation safety, but cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently support hook-initiated session rollover.

options.title: Approve after-compaction-only API
options.body: Keep the capability narrowly available on after_compaction contexts, retain current-session binding, and require lifecycle-safe implementation plus real runtime proof.

options.title: Approve broader hook API
options.body: Intentionally expose resetSession to general embedded hook contexts and document which hooks receive it, its ordering guarantees, and the resulting session-state risks.

options.title: Do not add reset capability
options.body: Keep session reset outside plugin hooks and pursue a narrower compaction continuation or lifecycle signal instead.

recommendation.title: Approve after-compaction-only API
recommendation.body: Keep the capability narrowly available on after_compaction contexts, retain current-session binding, and require lifecycle-safe implementation plus real runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest feature-history connection to the adjacent compaction and reset hook contract.
